Documentation section docs/loans.md#Loans > Overdue loans:

`overdue(loans, today)` returns the loans past their due date. Pass `grace_days`
to ignore the ones that are only a little late.

The chunk bookshelf/loans.py::overdue before the change:

def overdue(loans, today, grace_days=0):
    return [loan for loan in loans if (today - loan.due).days > grace_days]

And after it:

def overdue(loans, today):
    return [loan for loan in loans if today > loan.due]

What the change made wrong: `overdue` no longer accepts `grace_days`, so the documentation’s claim that you can pass it to ignore slightly late loans is now wrong.
